children: RNS Number : 0845V  Natwest Markets PLC  16 September 2026
The Company declares an interim dividend for the financial year ending 31 December 2026 of 40.04838p per ordinary share.
The interim dividend will be paid on 25 September 2026 to shareholders on the register at the close of business on 24 September 2026. The ex-dividend date is 24 September 2026.
